source_delivery: 智域基石 Logo V2 (local delivery bundle, png/svg/jpg exports)

policy.svg: source of truth for geometry and color
policy.png: bundled raster delivery; use directly for web/social/office export
policy.png_hires: large icon exports for app icon, avatar, favicon, large-format
policy.jpg: preview only; not bundled; fetch from the source folder when needed

verified.method: rsvg-convert render of each SVG compared against bundled PNG at native size

rendering.required: rsvg-convert (librsvg) or another spec-complete SVG renderer
rendering.known_bad: ImageMagick's internal MSVG/XML renderer mangles the gradient stops in these files; it renders them darker and flattens parts of the mark. Do not use `magick file.svg` for logo output.
rendering.safe_fallback: Use the bundled PNG directly instead of converting the SVG yourself.
rendering.after_render: Verify against the bundled PNG with `magick compare -metric RMSE` before placing the logo.

naming.color: 白色渐变 / 白色纯色 / 蓝色渐变 / 蓝色纯色 / 黑色
naming.lettering: 无文字 / 中文 / 英文 / 中英文
naming.orientation: 横版 / 竖版 / 方形 / 方圆通用
naming.form: 组合标 / 文字标 / 图形标
